answer: Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 5 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Because the gale reference is updated at each cipher checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the saffron audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism therefore earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 47 aliases however many keys the operator holds. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
